test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **Select the sentence which has no spelling error.**

options.text: Gupta empire posed a competetoin to the invaders in ancient India.
Neeta represented Global School in the state level debate competition.
There is a high market compettion due to the advent of online shopping.
The cooking compitition was judged by the head chef of Garland Hotels.

solution:
The sentence with no spelling error is **'****Neeta represented Global School in the state level debate competition.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word *competition *which means the activity or condition of striving to gain or win something by defeating or establishing superiority over others *has been incorrectly spelled in **options 1, 3 and 4.***

 
 
• ​*Option 1 - *competetoin 
 
• *Option 3 - *compettion 
 
• *Option 4 - *compitition 
 
 
 
• Only **option 2 **has the correct spelling for the word, making it the **correct answer.**
